pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing beside a large heavy plant pot by a garden gate.
Pip the sparrow pushing weakly at a big pot, unable to move it, looking discouraged.
Pip the sparrow resting for a moment beside a pot, then standing back up to try again.
Pip the sparrow straining hard against a pot, feathers puffed out with effort.
Pip the sparrow finally tipping a big pot upright by himself, triumphant.
Pip the sparrow standing proudly next to an upright pot, smiling.
Pip the sparrow hopping happily around a pot by a garden gate, delighted with himself.
